blocks.text: Ukraine peace talks: US envoys arrive in Russia to meet with Putin

The US president's son-in-law Jared Kushner and envoy Steve Witkoff are in Russia to meet Vladimir Putin. The expected meeting comes after two days of trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi. Follow DW for more.
